items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So he came by Gladys' house.

ctx.x: So that night we were going to a dance. So Gladys told me that we were going to this dance at the Lion's Club. And I had just made thirteen years old, so I was going to the dance. My mother was at the dance, too. And Danny came to the dance. So he stayed until 12 o'clock, because he had to go to work the next day.

So about two days later, we saw Danny coming. They called him Sundu then. So Gladys said, "Well, look at Sundu coming." I said, "Yeah." So he came by Gladys' house. And he was supposed to be coming to Gladys, but I must have looked good to him, because he'd come to see me.
So a couple of nights afterwards he come again. So we get on the steps, you know, and we didn't know her mother was watching...
